notes.title: V23 - Housekeeping update
notes.notes:

[list]
[*] Resolved the broken Full Steam Leaderboards button
[*] Resolved tutorial bug spinning out of control
[*] Resolved crash on exit on Mac

[*] Full Steamdeck support confirmed
[*] Updated store page and features where appropriate
[*] Changed share button to now copy message/score to clipboard so you can use it anywhere instead of opening up a direct link to Twitter
[*] Decreased install size
[*] Updated the Unity backend
[*] Implemented several translation suggestions

adamvision <3

notes.title: Ding Dong XL Version 7 Update
notes.notes:
A new challenge awaits you in the brand new game changing Infinite Mode! Improved graphics, better balance, and many more additions and changes. Check out Ding Dong XL V7 now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32763348/a4d869a960a2e0915114ecc60bc25c23a3a4f052.gif[/img]

Patch Notes: (additional leader boards + online for switch)
[list][*] New Infinite play mode added
[*] New Unlock-able Space Rocks skin
[*] Bonus Points power-up is now worth 5 Points
[*] Added Bit Blaster, Orbt, and Diamo songs for each of the special characters
[*] When you're stationary with a time slow power-up, the growth of the ball will stop completely
[*] Early button presses after death will not be erroneously detected
[*] Power-up timers correctly reset when dying and restarting they now also disappear upon death 
[*] Pink enemy now correctly has it's trail fade in/out with the rest of the enemy
[*] Modified and added some little secrets here and there
[*] Re-balanced some late game elements to ensure there are always viable paths to take and made 250+ not dependent on power-ups
[*] Player can now remain idle slightly longer before exploding
[/list]
I hope you enjoy the latest update, and if you do, make sure to leave a Steam review and share the game with your friends. Thanks for the continued support of my games. 

-Adam Nickerson ([url=https://twitter.com/nickervision]@nickervision[/url])

notes.title: 'Diamo XL' now available
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28434536/3059a3fd58476de522254c6456403f0ad7b8b3b4.gif[/img]
 [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/715010/Diamo_XL/] [b]Diamo XL[/b] [/url] is now available on Steam for PC, Mac, Linux.

Survive the constant onslaught of obstacles by moving your character to all five zones within the Diamond. Collect points before the enemies smash them and keep moving to keep your multiplier high. Fill in the four triangles to complete the Diamond and get bonus points.

This is an 'XL' version of my unreleased mobile game 'Diamo'. I have added/changed a variety of things to make it more suitable for the Steam platform. I have been learning to make games in my free time and love making small-yet-solid arcade games with simple mechanics. [b]Please expect 'Diamo XL' to be a small, re-playable, arcade score-chaser game where the only basic goals are to constantly beat your previous score and unlock a handful of alternate player characters.[/b]

Thanks to the unexpected success of my previous Steam games [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/433950] [b]Bit Blaster XL[/b] [/url] and [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/615610/Orbt_XL/] [b]Orbt XL[/b] [/url]  I have been able to spend a lot more time learning more about game development and intend to release more bite sized arcade games like this as I also start to develop bigger and better projects. I really appreciate all the feedback and support the community has given me.

Thank you to everyone for the support of my small games, it has been life changing. Also [b]PLEASE[/b] if you enjoyed Diamo XL make sure to leave a brief Steam review for it if you can, as I have found it to be one of the most important tools for getting others to notice my games.

Thanks for the support!
Adam Nickerson

notes.title: V3 Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/824567239163844457/7DA4439B68EE0B42E50A8199B90A475310E9FC4D/[/img]
[h1]orbt xl -  V3[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added a new planet “Plumbish”, which now also changes the look of the internal black hole. (also comes with an achievement, which I now know a lot of people don't like when you add achievements, so I will keep this in mind in the future)
[*]Improved in-game and store translations for Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Finnish, French, Japanese, Polish and Korean [b]thanks to community help[/b]
[*]Spacebar can now be used in place of enter for navigating menus as well.
[*]Put more checks in place to ensure misclicks/button presses in menus don’t get accepted and cause undesirable effects.
[*]Added another check to ensure that buttons could not be resized accidentally by getting stuck in the on position.
[*]When starting a round, the spin will now begin at the rotation opposite to the last round played. (unless you just opened the game) This will hopefully help alleviate anyone's room spinning after playing too long :)
[*]Added the hidden ability to delete your best high score that is saved by pressing the “Delete” key and “Y” key at the same time when exiting the game and on the "Thanks" screen. (since with cloud save its a lot harder to clear your score if you for some reason need/want to). I will probably implement something better for this in the future.
[*]Added another check to hopefully curb some of the fake scores before they’re posted in the leaderboards.
[*]The blackhole enemy and change direction enemy now correctly activate the moment they hit the center blackhole, this should allow players better ability to anticipate and react to these enemies effects.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for playing and sharing the game with your friends and family. [b]If you are enjoying orbt xl, please make sure to leave a brief Steam Review[/b] and let others know to check it out. The Steam review system is incredibly important for helping others find my small games.

I read all your comments whether I am able to respond or not, I am always observing and listening to your ideas :)

Thanks for the support!
Adam Nickerson
[url=www.nickervisionstudios.com] [b]Nickervision Studios[/b] [/url]
[url=www.twitter.com/nickervision] [b]Follow me on Twitter[/b] [/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/615610

notes.title: V2 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]orbt xl -  V2[/h1]
[list]
[*]Resolved the issue where sometimes a second planet would incorrectly appear. Also put in checks in case it happens again it can be resolved by going to main menu and starting a new round.
[*]Resolved problem where sometimes when clicking the retry button, the whole game would play that round slightly shifted off center.
[*]Fixed leader board not being clickable by mouse (It was a capital ‘B’ not a lowercase ‘b’ After all that, that’s all it was. Bloody hell.)
[*]Resolved (hopefully) the Resizing issues that occurred when some buttons were clicked in an unusual manner (which can be resolved with a restart of the game if it ever occurs again)
[*]Changed a number of in-game, store page, trailer, screenshot, and what felt like a billion other related graphics after a complaint that my graphics were too similar.
[*]New Achievement related to near misses :)
[*]Fixed some translation in game and all over store page, thanks to community contributors. Please don’t hesitate to contact me if you can improve translations for any language :)
[/list]

Thank you everyone for playing and sharing the game with your friends and family. Thanks so much for the support. If you are enjoying orbt xl, make sure to leave a brief Steam Review and let others know to check it out.

Thanks for the support!
Adam Nickerson

notes.title: ‘orbt xl’ now available on Steam
notes.notes:
[img]http://cloud-3.steamusercontent.com/ugc/813307204487112424/5CFCBBDA58666CC46ADC2C8CEF575B110D6EF6C0/[/img]

 [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/615610] [b]orbt xl[/b] [/url] is now available on Steam for PC, Mac, Linux.

Stay in orbit while avoiding obstacles or being sucked into a black hole. Survive as long as you can while dodging and weaving between the various obstacles, the closer you orbit to the center; the faster you achieve points. The longer you last, the harder it gets. The simple one button controls either increases or decreases your orbit as you press it or don’t.

This is an 'XL' version of my mobile game 'orbt'. I have added/changed a variety of things to make it more suitable for the Steam platform. I have been learning to make games in my free time and love making small-yet-solid arcade games with simple mechanics. [b] Please expect 'orbt xl' to be a small, re-playable, arcade score-chaser game where the only basic goals are to constantly beat your previous score and unlock a variety of cosmetic skins. [/b] 

Thanks to the immense success of my first Steam game [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/433950] [b]Bit Blaster XL[/b] [/url] I have been able to spend a lot more time lately learning more about game development and intend to release more bite sized arcade games like this as I also start to develop bigger and better projects. I really appreciate all the feedback and support the community has given me and I hope to see some of that same support for orbt xl and my future projects.

Thank you to everyone for the support and I really hope that you have some fun with orbt xl. Please, if you do, make sure to leave a brief review on Steam and share with family and friends, it makes a HUGE difference in getting the game out there and having people give it a shot.

Thanks for the support!
Adam Nickerson

notes.title: Available April 21st 9AM (PST)
notes.notes:
My new game [b]orbt xl[/b] will be available April 21st 9AM (PST) for $0.99USD.

Thanks to everyone that has supported my other arcade score chaser [b]Bit Blaster XL[/b], it has helped me rearrange some things in my life to spend more time making games like this. I hope that if you enjoyed BBXL you will have some fun with orbt xl too. 

My experience in the last year with BBXL has really helped me make orbt xl a much more solid package right out of the gate. Including a variety of features and improvements that you all encouraged me to add to Bit Blaster XL. While they are all small things like volume sliders, resolutions options, rebinding controls etc, they all make the end game experience a better value.

As with BBXL, expect orbt xl to be a bite sized experience great for playing a round here and there while in a queue or binge playing just one more round for hours.

Thanks so much for the support and look forward to much more from me this year as I have many more things to come now that I can devote more time to this. :)

Adam Nickerson
